title: fix(ci): satisfy Swift status text formatting
body:
## What Problem This Solves

The [macOS CI formatting step](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/44024086924/job/133845960267) fails because the Talk status text declares a redundant `String` type. The same line is still present on main.

## User Impact

No behavior or appearance change. The macOS formatting gate passes again.

## Why This Change Was Made

Apply SwiftFormat 0.63.1's `redundantType` fix to this one declaration. Every branch already returns a `String`.

## Evidence

- Pinned SwiftFormat reproduced the exact failure at `WebChatSwiftUI.swift:886` before the change.
- `./scripts/format-swift.sh macos` passes after the change: 440 app files and 35 supporting files require no formatting.
- `git diff --check` passes; the entire diff is one removed type annotation.
- Local autoreview against `b9a72b5bef8d` was scoped-clean through P2.

The later Swift test job timeout is separate; this change only fixes the proven formatting failure.
